spec.studio_prompt: A Scandinavian modern dining armchair measuring 52 cm wide, 55 cm deep, and 78 cm high. The chair features a continuous curved, low-profile wraparound backrest and rounded seat cushion upholstered in pale greige woven fabric (#d7d6d0, #b6ac9b). The base consists of an architectural A-frame structure with tapered splayed legs made of solid natural light oak (#9a805a) showing fine wood grain and a matte finish. A small rectangular fabric tag is visible on the outer side edge of the backrest.
